statement: In California, except for the statutory exceptions in the same chapter (such as sale of a business), every contract by which anyone is restrained from engaging in a lawful profession, trade, or business of any kind is to that extent void, and the section is read broadly to void employment noncompetes however narrowly tailored (Bus. & Prof. Code § 16600(a)-(b)).
caveat: Sections 16600.1 and 16600.5 add employer notice duties and enforcement exposure for maintaining void noncompetes; customer non-solicits are frequently void under the same rule. This repo does not review specific covenants.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
